# Contributing

Read the project's own page. Write the entry from that page. Open a contribution with the form in [ISSUE_TEMPLATE/contribution.yml](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/contribution.yml), or edit the README directly.

## Entry

```markdown
## Name

Two or three sentences. The name stays plain text.

- Repository: [https://github.com/org/repo](https://github.com/org/repo)

> [!NOTE]
> Click below to see more details.

<details>
<summary>Notes</summary>

License, last push, stars, and one row per category.
The wording is the project's. Tag it `README`, `Docs`, or `Site`.

</details>
```

Skip the repository line when there is no public repo, and put the vendor page in Notes. Other links stay in Notes. Leave a blank line after `<summary>`.

## Where

- A public repository: `# Open Source`. NukeRat stays first. Havoc stays directly under Sliver.
- Vendor page, no public repo: `# Commercial`.

Do not add install commands, operating steps, or a category the page does not state.

List text is [CC0](../license).
